name: River Stablecoin
description: River is building the circulatory system for crypto, connecting liquidity, yield and contributions across chains. Powered by the omni-CDP stablecoin protocol, earn, leverage, and scale — all without selling your assets.
mintRedeemDescription: River's Omni-CDP module allows users to access liquidity by depositing collateral, enabling them to borrow up to 90.91% of the collateral's value in satUSD
